lastCompletedStory.title: Fix version.ts comment and add package.json parity assert

nextStoryContext: US-002 reworded the src/version.ts comment (no longer describes package.json's version field as hypothetical) and added a real parity test in test/version.test.ts that reads package.json via Bun.file(new URL('../package.json', import.meta.url)).json() and asserts pkg.version === CAM_VERSION strictly. Raised two file-size ceilings (src/version.ts 20->22, test/version.test.ts 84->91) with a tracker-ref entry in scripts/file-size-budget.json's _ref field per the established convention (see patterns.md ~line 432). No re-embed needed (non-templated files). US-003 (next story) targets a stale merge-watch comment + dead CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS branch -- unrelated surface, no shared state with US-002.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.file(path).json() confirmed to return a Promise resolving the file's parsed JSON contents; accepts string paths and file:// URLs, matching the implementation.
